physical_uv_scale_note: Local geometric face area vs UV area is a diagnostic, not a guarantee for rotated or curved planar projections. Node scale must remain1 because physical tiling is baked into loops. Object nonunit scale may further alter world texel density.
visibility_note: Categories overlap: an assembly source can also be hidden. Visible exportable excludes all three flags plus render/viewport/local hidden objects. Evaluated triangles include modifiers, count instances, and exclude curves/fonts/lights.
